situation: A schema needs to store an invoice total that will be summed and reconciled against a bank statement.

expect.branch: integer minor units plus a currency column
expect.because: float cannot represent 0.10 exactly and the first reconciliation will be off by fractions of a cent

situation: A schema needs the date a human wrote on an invoice, used across several timezones.

expect.because: a moment stored where a human-named date belongs produces off-by-one-day errors across timezone boundaries

situation: The app tracks customers, suppliers and staff. The same phone number frequently belongs to all three.

expect.branch: one table with a type column
expect.because: separate tables force triple entry and a permanent reconciliation problem when one person is all three roles

situation: A recorded payment amount was wrong and needs correcting.

expect.because: an UPDATE destroys the history that makes the ledger auditable, and the original value is unrecoverable
